# The FlexFlow - Complete Agency Information & Capabilities Manifest

## The Core Problem Addressed

Traditional agency models route client briefs through account executives, strategists, and project managers before reaching junior executioners. Communication degrades, turnaround times stretch into months, and creative quality diverges from business goals.

The FlexFlow eliminates intermediary layers. The two founders directly scope the engagement, engineer the digital assets, configure the tracking pipelines, and run campaign iterations — capping capacity at three active builds at a time.

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Web Design & Custom Architecture (Sprint: 4 Weeks)
- High-fidelity Figma design systems with strict component governance.
- Clean semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 with custom properties, and zero-framework static DOM performance.
- Sub-second LCP, sub-100ms INP, CLS 0, and 100% first-pass readability for OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot.

### 2. AI Visibility & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO) (Sprint: 5 Days)
- Optimization for conversational discovery platforms: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- Passage-level citability (134–167 word self-contained answer blocks), IndexNow / Bing Webmaster pipelines, and third-party entity consensus.
- Complete Schema.org JSON-LD `@graph` construction connecting Organization, Founders, Services, and verified `sameAs` authorities.

### 3. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) (Sprint: Monthly Cadence)
- Commercial intent keyword research focusing on high-converting transactional queries rather than vanity volume.
- Entity SEO, canonical hygiene, XML sitemaps, robots.txt crawler management, and technical debt remediation.

### 4. Performance Marketing & Paid Acquisition (Sprint: 7-Day Launch)
- Direct-response campaign architecture across Meta (Facebook & Instagram Ads) and Google Ads.
- Automated lead triage integrating WhatsApp Business and CRM webhooks for sub-60-second follow-up.
- Verified Cost-Per-Lead (CPL) maintained below ₹60 for competitive regional and national campaigns.

### 5. Brand Identity & Systems (Sprint: 2–3 Weeks)
- Strategic brand positioning, typography selection, contrast-accessible color palettes, and component design tokens.

### 6. Social Content Batches (Sprint: 30-Post Batch)
- 30-day production batches for founder personal branding and corporate presence.

## Verified Portfolio Track Record

- [Voyage India Travel](https://theflexflow.in/work/travel-agency-ads): Direct-to-WhatsApp holiday booking campaign generating 160+ qualified holiday package inquiries at ₹14.54 CPL on ₹2,542.35 total spend across Kashmir, Delhi-Agra, and Hyderabad circuits.
- [Zara Salon & Spa](https://theflexflow.in/work/salon-ads): Hyperlocal 5km South Delhi geofenced paid social campaign reaching 1.08M+ impressions at ₹2.35 CPM with 28+ direct high-ticket booking inquiries at ₹45.00 per lead.
- [Polynomial Protocol](https://theflexflow.in/work#polynomial): L2 decentralized perpetuals platform. Shipped live in 14 days, resulting in 4x deposit growth in 60 days and sub-90s user onboarding.
- [Post Bridge](https://theflexflow.in/work#post-bridge): Social scheduling SaaS. Redesigned onboarding and feature demonstration, increasing free trial sign-ups 3x with a +38% rise in trial-to-paid retention.
- [SuperX](https://theflexflow.in/work#superx): X creator tool. Shipped visual redesign, doubling trial conversion rates with 250,000+ launch impressions.
